claim: Per-node routing M1-M3 plumbing causes NO regression. E-PN1 (denoising opus-everywhere + per_node_routing=true, runtime_state.per_node_routing left empty since the M2-followup engine hook is not yet wired) achieved medal=GOLD at score 0.00994, total $10.67. This matches the X205 baseline (gold, score 0.01227, $10.59) within ±2% — well inside the design spec's ±15% tolerance for E-PN1. The pluming change set (LlmConfig.per_node_routing flag + RuntimeState.per_node_routing dict + engine.options._model_for_unit fallback chain + route_async on all 3 routers + per-node models_by_role at ingest) is safe under load. The flag can be flipped on without changing the run-level behavior, which is the prerequisite for adding the engine hook in the M2-followup PR.

implementation_commits.milestone: M1 — NodeRoutingContext + route_async on all 3 routers

comparison_to_baseline.delta_score_pct: -19% (BETTER score — same routing run-to-run noise; E021 documents denoising variance)

scope: Single Phase 2 run validating the M1-M3 plumbing. The engine hook (M2-followup) that POPULATES runtime_state.per_node_routing is not yet wired, so per_node_routing=true here is effectively a no-op flag — the per-node mapping fallback layer always returns empty and ``_model_for_unit`` cascades to the run-level models_by_role. This is precisely the no-regression invariant the design spec § 7 requires.
limitations: n=1. Denoising-opus has n=2 gold runs across X205 and E-PN1; the loop policy's single-run-unambiguous-result criterion is met for the no-regression claim, but a 2nd E-PN1 rerun would confirm.

This validates the PLUMBING only. The actual cost lever — per-node routing decisions that vary by node — requires the M2-followup engine hook (calling router.route_async at node materialization). Until that lands, E-PN2/3/4 cannot run.

implications.plumbing_gate_status: GREEN — M1-M3 ready for M2-followup engine hook to land on top.
implications.follow_up: Implement M2-followup: at node materialization in engine/node_lifecycle_runner.run_node_lifecycle (or the inner spawning loop), construct a NodeRoutingContext from the node's depth/parent_metric/best_metric_so_far + the cost ledger + the medal threshold (when known), call await router.route_async(node_ctx=ctx), store the result in runtime_state.per_node_routing[node_id]. Cap LLM-router calls via per_node_redecide_band. With that landed, E-PN2 (budget-aware downgrade) and E-PN3 (threshold-aware upgrade) become runnable.

next_actions: Land M2-followup engine hook on qi_memory_router_v3 (separate PR).
Author static per-node rules in policy.json § per_node so E-PN2/3 have something to consult.
Then run E-PN2 (leaf budget-aware) and E-PN3 (leaf threshold-aware).
E-PN4 (LLM unseen task) requires a concrete task pick — jigsaw-toxic or nyc-taxi-fare are candidates.
